en.headline: Observatory cancels Strong Monsoon Signal after morning winds ease
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Strong Monsoon Signal at 11:45am on Tuesday, while the Red Fire Danger Warning remains in force with extreme fire risk.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Strong Monsoon Signal at 11:45am on Tuesday after northerly winds moderated.
The signal had been in force since early Monday morning amid a strong northeast monsoon. Earlier in the day, Cheung Chau had recorded sustained winds of 52 km/h with gusts to 72 km/h.
The Red Fire Danger Warning, issued at 6:10am on Monday, remains in force, indicating extreme fire risk. The Observatory advised the public to remain alert and take necessary fire precautions.
Temperatures stayed cool after an early low of 17.5 degrees at the Observatory headquarters, with dry conditions continuing.

zh.headline: 天文台上午11時45分取消強烈季候風信號
zh.dek: 天文台周二上午11時45分取消強烈季候風信號，紅色火災危險警告仍然生效，火災危險性極高。
body: 香港天文台於周二上午11時45分取消強烈季候風信號，偏北強風已減弱。
信號自周一清晨起生效，受強烈東北季候風影響。今早較早時長洲錄得持續風速每小時52公里、陣風72公里。
周一清晨6時10分發出的紅色火災危險警告仍然生效，表示火災危險性極高。天文台提醒市民提高警覺，採取適當防火措施。
天文台總部今早錄得最低氣溫17.5度後，天氣持續清涼乾燥。
